name: extension-host core + desktop 1.0.1 + workspace 1.0.2
comment: The signed application as shipped from Koine 0.5.0: desktop release/schema 1.0.1, the first cut of window layout,
and workspace release/schema 1.0.2. Its design differs from the desktop 1.0.0 profile's
(core-desktop-workspace-discovery-extension-host.json) by the window layout coordinates alone, so its canonical
digest differs on the same host and printer. The candidate versions are pinned here, apart from the SDL and the
digest, because an identical schema and digest cannot say which binary ran.
